apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.
apps.versionDescription:
SideStore 0.6.4 | SideStore

## Build Info

Built at (UTC): `Wed Sep 09 17:59:46 2026`
Built at (UTC date): `2026-09-09`
Commit SHA: `f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9`
Version: `0.6.4`

#### What's Changed:
- **Developer Portal in Settings**: Manage your Apple Developer App IDs, Provisioning Profiles, Certificates, Devices, and App Groups directly inside the app for both paid and free team types.
- **Manual Profile Creation**: Paid developer accounts can now create manual profiles on app without having to reach developer portal.
- **Certificate Management**: Certificate CSR + create/revoke in developer portal, export, import, view all data including ASN1, keys, and much more metadata.
- **Full Two-Factor Authentication**: Added support for SMS verification, Voice phone call in addition to trusted devices during login 2FA Challenge.
- **Cellular Refresh**: Now one can enable cellular refresh with shortcuts to refresh on the go without waiting for wifi anytime anywhere (credits to @spidy123222)
- **Health Check**: Newer dedicated Health Check section in settings to diagnose device and network communication issues quickly.
- **On-Device Anisette**: Switched to on-device anisette data generation as the primary anisette data source of OTP requests during 2FA. No more need for Remote anisette servers.
- **App & Mach-O Inspector**: Inspect any app's internal files, Mach-O binaries, and embedded provisioning profiles right from App Info.
- **Storage Explorer**: Full view of all storage managed by the app and its sideloaded apps including caches, appgroups, tmp dirs, private documents dir etc.
- **Faster VPN peer auto-discovery**: Parallel connection probing discovers your device on the local vpn network much faster by doing a parallel probe for device services like lockdown/rppairing ports.
- **Dual Connection Modes**: Switch between LocalDevVPN/WireGuard and Remote servers as for loopback as required.
- **Account Config Export**: Export and import your accounts and sources as `.sideconf` files for quick setup or migration.
- **Full Liquid-Glass support**: Added smooth pill buttons, improved scroll animations, and fixed UI flickering in the My Apps tab.

#### ⚠️Known Issue
- iOS 16 users may have difficulty connecting to LocalDevVPN and is being actively worked on.

#### Full Changelog: [0.6.3...0.6.4](https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/239fc7c2b7f3c319d3608bd49c30d1457216d5df...f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9)

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SideStore can use local network access to discover Bonjour (mDNS) services on your network. This is not required for core functionality.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 stable releases; the rolling nightly and alpha tags are pre-releases and are not tracked. Requires a pairing file and, on iOS 17+, a JIT/StikDebug-style enabler for some features.
